title: Nobody Owns the Light

mood.label: Uneasy
mood.summary: An uneasy day: tankers hit in Hormuz as Washington and Tehran both claim the strait, Ukraine blacked out, diplomats attacked in the West Bank, France burning over prices. Against it: coral recovering fast, the Pope home from surgery, solar booming in the Philippines.

style.genre: dark electronic — kalimba, muted guitar, TR-606

lines: Two flags say they own the same strait,
tankers burning where the channel bends.
A million homes in Ukraine gone dark,
Limoges in flames before the evening ends.
Diplomats chased down a West Bank road,
Kenya counts to seven, keeping still.
The IMF says the poor pay first,
the prices climbing up the hill.
But the coral's coming back to colour,
the Pope walked home through Roman stone,
